route_note: R1: Kokkos' own CMake build at the exact commits (87415792f5 buggy, db1a77ddc4 fixed), CUDA backend + Serial, CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release (-O3 -DNDEBUG), -lineinfo through CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS, nvcc_wrapper as CXX, embedded with add_subdirectory in a 4-line CMake project whose only target is the driver (linked to Kokkos::kokkoscore); same flags and same scripts for both variants. Three deviations, all outside the kernel file (core/src/Cuda/Kokkos_Cuda_ReduceScan.hpp is untouched and no Kokkos source is edited): (1) arch: this revision (Kokkos 3.6.99) has no Kokkos_ARCH_ADA89 keyword (the record's ADA89 option does not exist yet), so Kokkos_ARCH_AMPERE86=ON is used (Kokkos' recommendation for Ada at that time) and a wrapper around nvcc_wrapper rewrites the emitted -arch=sm_86 to -arch=sm_89 (derived from $RW_NVCC_FLAGS); the driver binary has 18 cubins sm_89 plus compute_89 PTX (cuda_elfs.py), no sm_86. (2) CUDA 13.4 incompatibilities of the 2022 sources, worked around with a compat PRE-INCLUDE (rw_cuda_compat.h, passed with nvcc's NVCC_APPEND_FLAGS='-include ...', declarations only): without it both variants fail to compile: core/src/Cuda/Kokkos_Cuda_Half_Conversion.hpp lines 263,268,273,279,284,289,294,300: 'error: no suitable user-defined conversion from "Kokkos::Experimental::half_t" to "__half" exists' and '__half2double is undefined' (8 errors per TU, the same with nvcc 12.2/12.5), and core/src/Cuda/Kokkos_CudaSpace.cpp(612): 'error: no suitable constructor exists to convert from "int" to "cudaMemLocation"' / 'argument of type "cudaStream_t" is incompatible with parameter of type "unsigned int"' (cudaMemPrefetchAsync/cudaMemAdvise changed signature in CUDA 13). The shim adds forwarding overloads for those CUDA functions only. (3) relocatability: Kokkos links the shared libcudart.so.13 without rpath, so the driver is relinked with the static CUDA runtime and RPATH=/opt/ohpc/pub/compiler/gcc/12.4.0/lib64 (libstdc++); it needs only libcuda.so.1 + system libs. The -lineinfo SASS check of route R1 is owned by helper C: see targets/hecbench-dxtc2-1/lineinfo.check (RESULT SAME).
driver: driver.cpp: Kokkos::parallel_reduce("rw_sum", RangePolicy<Cuda>(0, 1000), RwSumFunctor, double& s) (functor u += i, no KOKKOS_LAMBDA so no extended-lambda flag is needed); launches cuda_parallel_launch_local_memory<ParallelReduce<RwSumFunctor, RangePolicy<Cuda>, InvalidType, Cuda>>, whose scalar reduction runs CudaReductionsFunctor<...,false,false>::scalar_intra_warp_reduction (ReduceScan.hpp L529-L552). Prints 'kokkos-5 driver: n=1000 sum=499500.0 expected=499500.0 OK', rc 0 if the sum is right.
input: n = 1000 (record: n = 1..1000), one launch of the reduction kernel: about 4 blocks of 256 threads x ~30 shared/global accesses per thread, so about 3e4 thread-level accesses (estimated from the code, not measured), far below 1e7.
